name: compose-port-forwarder
description: Forwards the published ports of a docker compose project to the client machine. Remote windows only.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The extension runs the docker command line so it needs a trusted workspace.

composePortForwarder.enabled.description: Forward the published ports of docker compose projects. Remote windows only.

composePortForwarder.dockerPath.description: The docker command line to run on the remote machine.

enumDescriptions: Only projects whose compose file sits inside a folder of this window.
Every compose project the daemon is running.
composePortForwarder.scope.description: Which compose projects to forward. Falls back to all when the window has no folder open.

composePortForwarder.ignoredPorts.description: Host ports to leave alone. Write a single port as 5432 and a span as 9000-9100.

composePortForwarder.includeOneOff.description: Also forward containers started by docker compose run.

composePortForwarder.pollSeconds.description: Seconds between safety sweeps. Set to 0 to rely on docker events alone.

enumDescriptions: Also show a count in the status bar.
Also raise a notification for each new port.
composePortForwarder.notify.description: How loudly to report a forwarded port.
